meta.name: knowledge-base
meta.description: Write a technical spec after research. Distills exploration into structured decisions. On retries, read the existing spec instead of re-researching.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将调研结果整理成结构化的技术规格文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在调研后产出清晰的技术决策文档。
copy.tagline_en: Turn research into structured technical specs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce clear technical decisions after research.

howto.what: Claude 在完成技术调研后，会自动编写一份技术规格文件（.md格式），记录每个模型的来源、连接、过滤条件、预期粒度等决策及依据。如果该文件已存在，则直接读取并跳过重新调研。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 进行技术调研并建议输出结构化决策时触发，例如“写一个技术规格”或“记录本次调研的决策”。

say.text: 请为这个数据项目编写技术规格，包含每个模型的字段。
读取已有的技术规格并基于它继续工作。
say.note: Claude 会跳过重新调研直接使用已有规格。

howto.what_en: After research, Claude automatically writes a technical spec file (.md) documenting decisions for each model (sources, joins, filters, grain, etc.). If the file already exists, Claude reads it and skips re-research.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to conduct technical research and produce structured decisions, e.g., 'write a technical spec' or 'document this research'.

say_en.text: Write a technical spec for this data project, including all model fields.
Read the existing technical spec and continue working from it.
say_en.note: Claude skips re-research and uses the existing spec.
